fixture.status: complete source-defined relative-luminance dark-flash candidate; unevaluated
fixture.purpose: Separate T4 pathway response test; not direct L1/L2 or photoreceptor validation

responseLocator.units: mV relative to source prestimulus baseline
responseLocator.aggregation: source mean of five accepted repetitions

fixture.selectionRule: First indexed source cell, original position0, width1, duration40ms, dark polarity; stimulus metadata only

input.spatialScope: At illuminated bar pixels; all other display pixels remain background
input.physicalBackgroundQualification: Approximately31cd/m² in paper; not an absolute radiometric calibration
input.delaySource: Figure2/Figure2Code.m:613,711; fixed source measurement, no response-derived shift

baseline.rule: Mean voltage between first stored time>-250ms and first stored time>-50ms, inclusive, subtracted from source mean trace

limits: Only dark polarity avoids the unverified actual bright/background luminance ratio.
7ms is the paper code’s measured nominal arena delay, not a per-trial photodiode waveform.
The exact original protocol export and arena-delay measurement script are not in the downloaded Figure2 archive.
Source-owned preprocessing code is pinned separately; voltage values were not read to re-verify subtraction numerically.
The original recording is current-clamp soma voltage with a small holding current, not a voltage-indicator signal.
A local T4 test needs a specified spatial pathway and mV observation model; this pair alone does not validate the connectome.

populationInventory.scope: All source dark-flash axis combinations; no response-derived selection
populationInventory.animalIdentityLimit: The five top-level fields carry no animal identifiers or stable cell IDs; ordinals only.
populationInventory.indexing: MATLAB result(position,duration,width,value); HDF5 reference arrays reverse these axes.
